name: The Singapore EDITION
insider_take: Where Marina Bay's glittering skyline meets Ian Schrager's legendary nightlife vision – this is Singapore's most electrifying urban sanctuary.
whats_special: The Singapore EDITION occupies floors 20-36 of a striking skyscraper, offering unobstructed views of Marina Bay Sands and the iconic Singapore Flyer. The hotel's PUNCH Room bar on the 20th floor is already legendary among locals, while the rooftop pool provides an Instagram-worthy backdrop against the city's dramatic skyline. As part of Ian Schrager's EDITION brand, it seamlessly blends boutique sophistication with five-star Marriott service standards.
pro_tip: Book a Marina Bay view room on floors 30+ for the ultimate Singapore experience – you'll wake up to breathtaking sunrise views over the world's most expensive infinity pool at Marina Bay Sands.
dont_miss: Evening cocktails at PUNCH Room with panoramic city views, and a quick walk to Marina Bay for the spectacular light and water show at 8pm and 9pm nightly. The nearby Merlion Park and Gardens by the Bay's Supertree Grove are just minutes away, making this the perfect base for Singapore's must-see attractions.
pros: Prime location in Marina Bay with stunning city and bay views
Contemporary luxury design with sophisticated modern aesthetics
Exceptional dining experiences with multiple acclaimed restaurants
State-of-the-art fitness facilities and wellness amenities
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury Marina Bay properties
Modern minimalist design may feel impersonal to some guests
